rows.role_title: Президент Российской Федерации — President of the Russian Federation
rows.text: The Federation Council schedules the election of the President of the Russian Federation for 14 March 2004; the resolution takes effect on official publication; signed S. M. Mironov, Moscow, 10 December 2003, No. 337-SF.
